snippet.title: NEO SONiC FiGHTiNG HEROES // SONiC GAMEPLAY TRAiLER
snippet.description:
Here’s the first look at SONiC in the new and improved NEO SONiC FiGHTiNG HEROES. With overhauled sprites and a revitalized moveset, Sonic is a hardcore rushdown that specializes in getting big confirms off his normals.

This showcases unveils newly added mechanics such as the highly requested Throws!


The game also has a Discord server! If we get enough members, events such as a Community Combo Contest and Tournaments will be hosted!

This can also be used to find opponents for online matches via Parsec!

https://discord.gg/jU74uUXSY
